content:
The **Throwing Knife** is a melee throwing weapon in *Fallout 76*.

## Gameplay[edit]

The knife is bare steel with a slight curve and four holes in the grip. When thrown the knife travels in a steep arc and will impact to the left of the crosshair.

Comparatively high damage and ease of crafting make this an excellent choice for any build at low levels. Throwing knives may sometimes be recovered from corpses.
